mapper.select: SELECT p.*, m.shop_name AS shopName, m.rating AS merchantRating FROM products p LEFT JOIN merchant_profiles m ON p.merchant_id = m.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.*, m.shop_name AS shopName, m.rating AS merchantRating FROM products p LEFT JOIN merchant_profiles m ON p.merchant_id = m.user_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND p.category = #{category}
ORDER BY p.sales DESC ORDER BY p.rating DESC ORDER BY p.price ASC ORDER BY p.price DESC ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
